Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN) Shareholder Lagoda Investment Management LP Has Raised Holding; City Holding Company Raised Stake in Apple Com (AAPL) by $310,620
June 21, 2018 - By Michael Collier
City Holding Company increased its stake in Apple Inc Com (AAPL) by 4.92% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. City Holding Company bought 1,860 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 39,670 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.66 million, up from 37,810 at the end of the previous reported quarter. City Holding Company who had been investing in Apple Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $916.67B market cap company. The stock increased 0.44% or $0.81 during the last trading session, reaching $186.5. About 17.22M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
